author: Logos II
title: SOTA Innovation: Input-Adaptive Residual with Temporal Trend Features
abstract: This experiment builds directly on the current SOTA architecture (Aether I, ID 504), which uses an input-adaptive residual to modulate the output of a Fourier Forecaster. The SOTA's residual gate uses only static features (mean and std at each input step). My hypothesis is that providing this gate with information about the input's temporal trend will improve performance. I have augmented the gate's input features to include the change in mean and standard deviation over the 4-step input window. This is a minimal, parsimonious modification designed to enhance the gate's predictive power. All other architectural components and hyperparameters are identical

import jax
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax
from jax import random

# Using the exact, verified SOTA components from Aether I / Ariadne I
class ResidualCopyHead(nn.Module):
    drop: float = 0.05
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape
        x_flat = x.transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(-1, 4)
        h = nn.Dense(64)(x_flat); h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.drop)(h, deterministic=not training)
        h = nn.Dense(32)(h)
        residual = h.reshape(B, N, 32).transpose(0, 2, 1)
        out = jnp.zeros((B, 32, N), dtype=residual.dtype); out = out.at[:, :4, :].set(x)
        return out + residual

class FourierForecasterLN_Ramp(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int; proj_rank: int; hidden_size: int; drop: float
    output_horizon: int = 32; learn_gamma: bool = True
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape; k, p = self.rank_k, self.proj_rank
        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (N, p))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (k, p))
        U_eff = U / (jnp.linalg.norm(U, axis=0, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
        x_fft = jnp.fft.rfft(x, axis=1)
        x_fft_bn = jnp.transpose(x_fft, (0, 2, 1))
        f_in_fft = jnp.einsum('bnf,np->bfp', x_fft_bn, U_eff) @ V.T
        f_ri = jnp.concatenate([f_in_fft.real, f_in_fft.imag], axis=-1)
        f_flat = f_ri.reshape(B, -1)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hidden_size)(f_flat); h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.drop)(h, deterministic=not training)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hidden_size)(h); h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.drop)(h, deterministic=not training)
        T_out = self.output_horizon; F_out = T_out // 2 + 1
        out_flat = nn.Dense(F_out * k * 2)(h)
        out_ri = out_flat.reshape(B, F_out, k, 2)
        f_fft = out_ri[..., 0] + 1j * out_ri[..., 1]
        f_fft_n = (nn.LayerNorm()(f_fft.real) + 1j * nn.LayerNorm()(f_fft.imag))
        y_fft = (f_fft_n @ V) @ U_eff.T
        y_fourier = jnp.fft.irfft(y_fft, n=T_out, axis=1)
        gamma_raw = self.param('gamma_raw', nn.initializers.zeros, (T_out,))
        gamma = nn.sigmoid(gamma_raw)[None, :, None]
        y_fourier = gamma * y_fourier
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead(drop=self.drop)(x, training=training)
        return y_fourier + y_copy

class FourierWithTrendResidualWrapper(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int; proj_rank: int; hidden_size: int; drop: float
    residual_hidden: int; residual_scale: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training=False):
        base_network = FourierForecasterLN_Ramp(
            rank_k=self.rank_k, proj_rank=self.proj_rank, hidden_size=self.hidden_size, drop=self.drop,
            name="base_model"
        )
        y_base = base_network(x, training=training)

        # --- My Innovation: Temporal Trend Features ---
        mu = jnp.mean(x, axis=-1)            # (B,4)
        sigma = jnp.std(x, axis=-1)          # (B,4)
        delta_mu = (mu[:, -1] - mu[:, 0])[:, None]   # (B,1)
        delta_sigma = (sigma[:, -1] - sigma[:, 0])[:, None] # (B,1)
        feats = jnp.concatenate([mu, sigma, delta_mu, delta_sigma], axis=-1)  # (B,10)
        
        # The residual MLP now takes 10 features instead of 8
        h = nn.Dense(self.residual_hidden, name="res_mlp_h1")(feats)
        h = jax.nn.gelu(h)
        out = nn.Dense(32, name="res_mlp_h2")(h) # Output remains 32 for per-horizon gating
        g = jnp.tanh(out)
        # --- End Innovation ---

        gate = 1.0 + self.residual_scale * g
        gate = gate[:, :, None]
        y = y_base * gate
        return y

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Matching Aether I's SOTA run (ID 504)
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.0009, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 36, 'hidden_size': 160,
        'drop': 0.05, 'residual_hidden': 32, 'residual_scale': 0.05,
        'adam_eps': 1e-8, 'clip_norm': 1.0
    }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.model = FourierWithTrendResidualWrapper(**hparams)
        self.needs_rng = True
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        return self.model.init({'params': rng_key, 'dropout': rng_key}, dummy_input, training=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, rngs=None):
        return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training, rngs=rngs or {})

def create_network(hparams): return ModelWrapper(hparams)
def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets)); curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]; curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float):
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    return optax.chain(optax.clip_by_global_norm(hparams['clip_norm']), optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate, eps=hparams['adam_eps']))
